ohacca: [ava + hana + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 To oppress.
ohacchaṃ: [u + hada + ssaṃ.] (kri) CL=7 [O(ava) + hada + ssaṃ. Moga, sya, 2. 341.] (He) will defecate. See - Ohadati (A).
ohadati: [u (o, ava)+hada + a+ti. ] (kri) CL=7 [See - Ohacchaṃ]. (A) (He) defecate. (B) He discharges excrement and urine.
ohadāmase: [u(o,ava)+hada+a+ma+(se-nipāta)] (kri) CL=7 (They) discharge excrement and urine. (prañña, sya.). See - Ohadati(B).
ohana: [ava+hana+yu] (na)  CL=7 Causes to immerse. See below.
ohanati: [ava + hana + a + ti] (kri) CL=7 He causes to move down. He causes to sink down. He immerses.
ohanaṭṭha: [ohana + attha] (pu) CL=7 The nature of immersion or sinking down.
ohaneti: [In Cariyā.402, Ohaneti taṃ. That should be Ohadetitaṃ]. See - Ohadeti.
ohanitvā: [ava + hana + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having oppressed. See - Ohacca.
ohara: [ava + hara + a + hi] (kri) CL=7 (1) May you bring. (2) May you put down. May you put down (something) and take up (something). (3) May you give up.
oharati: [ava + hara + a + ti] (kri) CL=7 (1) (He) takes or brings. (2) (He) places down. (He) places down and takes up. (3) (He) gives up.
oharatu: [ava + hara + a+ tu] (kri) CL=7 May you put down. May you put down and take up. See - Oharati (2).
oharituṃ: [ava + hara + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 Causes to immerse. See - Ohārituṃ.
ohariṇi: [(ava + hara + ṇī=) oharī + inī (itthīpaccaññaḥ.)] (thī) CL=7 (A river) that flows into the ocean. See also - Ohārinī.
ohaññeyya: [u + hana + ya + etha. ] (kri) CL=7 (He) should afflict, lose, and drift away. See - Ūhaññate (2).
ohi: [ava + hā + ya + tvā] (hī)yitvā (kri, vi) CL=7 (1) To stay behind. To remain behind. (2) To be sluggish.
ohita: [ava + dhā + ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) (A) Should be put down. (B) Should be removed or shaven. (C) Should be placed down. (D) Should be placed down and stood up or set up. (E) Should be hooked up. (2) Should be placed inside. Inclusive. Covered. (3) Should be shut up. Should be placed down. (4) Established.
ohitabhāra: [ohita + bhāra] (ti) CL=7 One who has a burden that should be given up.
ohitacitta: [ohita + citta] (ti) CL=7 One who has a mind that should be placed down.
ohitakhandha: [ohita + khandhabhāra] (kkhandha)bhāra (ti) CL=7 One who has the burden of a body that should be placed down or should be attained final dissolution of a body or should be passed into Nibbana.
ohitamukha: [ohita + mukha] (ti) CL=7 One who has a mouth that should be shut up. (One who has a face that should be cast down his eyes. Prañña, sya.)
ohitasota: [ohita + sota] (ti) CL=7 One who listens attentively.
ohitataca: [ohita + taca] (ti) CL=7 (A snake) that has a skin which should be given up.
ohitāsa: [ohitā + āsā] (ti) CL=7 One who wants to establish. See - Ohita (4).
ohiya: [ava + hā + ya + ti] (yya) ti (kri) CL=7 (He) stayed behind. See - Ohiyati (A).
ohiyi: [ava + hā + ya + ī] (kri) CL=7 (He) stayed behind. See - Ohiyati (A).
ohiyissati: [ava + hā + ya + ssati] (kri) CL=7 (He) stays behind. See - Ohīyati (A).
ohiyyaka: [ava + hā + ya + ṇvu] (ti) CL=7 One who stays behind.
ohiyyamānaka: [ava + hā + ya + māna + ka] (ti) CL=7 One who stays behind. See below.
ohiyyamānakabhikkhu: [ohiyyamānaka + bhikkhu] (pu) CL=7 (A bhikkhu) who stays behind.
ohiyyasi: [ava + hā + ya + si] (kri) CL=7 He stays behind. See - Ohīyati (A).
ohiyyatu: [ava + hā + ya + tu] (kri) CL=7 May he stay behind. See - Ohiyati (A).
ohiḷeti: [ava + hīḷa + ṇe + ti] (kri) CL=7 (He) makes disrespect or detests.
ohāpehi: [ava + hā + ṇāpe + hi] (kā, kri) CL=7 May (you) retreat or decrease. See - Ohāpehi.
ohārayitvā: [ata + hara + ṇaya + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having caused to bring down. Having made down. Having placed down. See also - Oropayitvā.
ohāraṇa: [ava + hara + ṇe + yu] (na) CL=7 (1) Removing. (Ti) (2) Causes to bring down. Placed down. Removed.
ohāraṇakkhaṇa: [ohāraṇa + khaṇa] (pu) CL=7 A moment of bringing down or removing. See below.
ohārehi: [ava + hara + ṇāpe + hi] (kā, kri) CL=7 (1) He causes to decrease as an inferior state. See - Ohāreti (2). He brings down. He puts down. See - Oharati (3).
ohārenta: [ata + hara + ṇe + anta] (ti) CL=7 Puts down. one who gives up.
ohāretabba: [ava + hara + ṇe + tabba] (ti) CL=7 Should be cleaned or shaven.
ohāreti: [ava + hara + ṇāpe + ti] (kā, kri) CL=7 (1) He analyzes. (2) He causes to decrease as an inferior state. (3) He causes to bring down. He placed down. He gives up.
ohāretvā: [ata + hara + ṇe + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having given up. Having put down. Having placed down or shaven.
ohārinī: [ava + hara + ṇī + inī(itthīpaccaññaḥ.)] (thī) CL=7 Carrying down. (A river) that carries, immerses, and flows down. See below. See also - Ohariṇī.
ohārita: [ava + hara + ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) Should be brought down. Should be placed down. Should be removed. (2) To remove. Removed.
ohāritakesamassu: [ohārita + kesamassu] (ti) CL=7 One who has hair and beard that should be shaven.
ohāritakesamassuka: [ohārita + kesamassu + ka] (ti) CL=7 One who has hair and a beard that should be shaven.
ohāritakkhaṇa: [ohārita + khaṇa] (ti) CL=7 A moment of removing.
ohārituṃ: [ava + hara + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To bring down or to cause to sink down. To immerse.
ohāriyamāna: [ava + hara + ya + māna] (ti) CL=7 Should be rejected or given up or shaven.
ohārāpetvā: [ata + hara + ṇāpe + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Bring it down Eliminate - give up.
ohārī: [ava + hara + ṇī.] (ti) CL=7 [In thī- ohārinī.] (1) (A river) that flows, and sinks into the ocean. (2) Carries to the lower realm. (3) One who approaches and brings (the head).
ohātuṃ: [ava + hā + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To leave away. See also - Ohīyati.
ohāvima: [ava + hu + ṇima] (ti) CL=7 Arises by worship. Should be worshiped.
ohāya: [ava + hā + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 (A) To give up. (B) To stop.
ohīna: [ava + hā + ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) (A) One who stays behind. (B) One who is left behind. (2) (A) One who draws back or is sluggish. (B) Decreased.
ohīnajana: [ohīna + jana] (pu) CL=7 A person who is left behind.
ohīnaka: [ohīna + ka] (ti) CL=7 (A) One who stays behind. (B) One who is left behind.
ohīnakabhikkhu: [ohīnaka + bhikkhu] (pu) CL=7 A bhikkhu who is left behind.
ohīnasamaya: [ohīna + samaya] (pu) CL=7 A period of staying behind.
ohīnatthera: [ohīna + thera] (pu) CL=7 (A thera) who is left behind.
ohīnavīriya: [ohīna + vīriya] (ti) CL=7 One who is a weak effort or a sluggish striving.
ohīyaka: [ava + hā + ya + ṇvu] (ti) CL=7 Stayed behind. (One) who is left behind. See below.
ohīyamāna: [ava + hā + ya + māna] (na) CL=7 Lagging or staying behind.
ohīyana: [ava + hā + ya + yu] (thī, na) CL=7 (1) Staying behind. (Ti) (2) One who is left behind.
ohīyanaka: [ohīyana + ka] (ti) CL=7 One who is left behind.
ohīyanalakkhaṇa: [ohīyana + lakkhaṇa] (na) CL=7 The sign of remaining. See - Ohīyana (1).
ohīyanasikkhāpada: [ohīyana + sikkhāpada]  CL=9 Ohīyana Vinaya rule.  Third anupaññatti of Bhikkhunī 3rd saṅghādisesa. (A vinaya rule that is laid down on account of a bhikkhunī who, while travelling with other nuns, stayed behind alone to relieve herself and was seduced and violated by people. Vi, 2. 295.)
ohīyanta: [ava + hā + ya + anta] (ti) CL=7 One who stays behind.
ohīyanādhikāra: [ohīyana + adhikāra] (pu) CL=7 The subject that explains staying behind.
ohīyanāpatti: [ohīyana + āpatti] (thī) CL=7 An offense that arises due to staying behind. Ohīyanāpatti.
ohīyasi: [ava + hā + ya + si] (kri) CL=7 They stayed behind. See - Ohīyati (A).
ohīyatiohiya: [ava + hā + ya + ti] (yya) ti (kri) CL=7 (A) He stays behind. (B) He remains or is left behind.
ohīyeyya: [ava + hā + ya + eyya] (kri) CL=7 Should he stay behind. See - Ohīyati (A).
ohīyi: [ava + hā + ya + ī] (kri) CL=7 He stayed behind. See - Ohīyati (A).
ohīyiṃsu: [ava + hā + ya + uṃ] (kri) CL=7 They stayed behind. See - Ohīyati (A).
ohīḷita: [ata + hīḷa + ta] (ti) CL=7 Should be detested.
ohīḷitarūpa: [ohīḷīta + rūpa] (ti) CL=7 One whose appearance is detesting.
ohaccha: [u + hada + ssaṃ.] (kri) CL=7 [O(ava) + hada + ssaṃ. Moga, sya, 2. 341.] (He) will defecate. See - Ohadati (A).
oharitu: [ava + hara + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 Causes to immerse. See - Ohārituṃ.
ohāritu: [ava + hara + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To bring down or to cause to sink down. To immerse.
ohātu: [ava + hā + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To leave away. See also - Ohīyati.
ohīyisu: [ava + hā + ya + uṃ] (kri) CL=7 They stayed behind. See - Ohīyati (A).
